review_goal: Move order-event delivery to an outbox while preserving atomic persistence and at-least-once delivery.

directions.prompt: Follow remote calls, storage access, loops, batching, caches, and side effects for production-scale failure modes.
Trace value, state, identity, ordering, and precision changes through their real business effects.
Trace errors, timeouts, retries, cancellation, concurrency, and resource lifecycle across the changed path.

findings.title: Initialize the outbox before writing the order
findings.body: When an existing `Database` has an initialized `orders` map but a nil `outbox` map—a valid setup before this change—`Save` commits the order and then panics while assigning to `database.outbox`. This leaves the order without its event and violates the new atomic-persistence guarantee; initialize or validate both maps before performing either write.
